documentation.content: The catalog-worker service answered more than 5 requests a minute with a server error for 5 minutes in a row (503 "no free instance" answers are left out because Cloud Tasks retries them). Batches may be failing. First open the catalog-worker service in Cloud Run and look at its Logs tab. If the errors started right after a deploy, roll back to the previous revision as the go-live runbook describes.
documentation.subject: Catalog: worker errors

conditions.displayName: catalog-worker 5xx responses other than 503, more than 5 a minute for 5 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="catalog-worker" AND metric.labels.response_code_class="5xx" AND metric.labels.response_code=monitoring.regex.full_match("5(0[0-24-9]|[1-9][0-9])")
